title: AI can write code, but the magic of a first project is unmatched! 🗽
why_read: A beginner's first HTML/CSS/JS project showcase with no novel technical content beyond personal learning reflection.
analysis: This is a first-project showcase by a self-described beginner building a simple webpage listing Indian states, using basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with some AI assistance. It's a nice personal milestone but has no technical depth, novel techniques, or lessons that would interest an experienced engineering audience. This kind of content is common on Dev.to but doesn't fit a digest aimed at substantive technical discussion.
